description: Three metrics in a row, e.g. user count + uptime + support.
whenToUse: Prompt mentions stats, metrics, or quantitative social proof.

description: Three features with icon, title, and description in columns.
whenToUse: Prompt mentions features, benefits, value-props, or capabilities in a grid.

description: Single customer quote with attribution and avatar.
whenToUse: Prompt mentions a testimonial, customer quote, or social proof quote.

description: Three article previews with image, tag, title, summary, and read-more link.
whenToUse: Prompt mentions newsletter digest, blog roundup, or article links.

description: Secondary CTA card with accent background, title, body, and pill button.
whenToUse: Prompt needs a secondary call-to-action, upgrade prompt, or "ready to start?" card.

description: Side-by-side pricing comparison with two tiers.
whenToUse: Prompt mentions pricing tiers, plan comparison, or subscription options.

description: Three numbered steps with big numbers and descriptions.
whenToUse: Prompt mentions how-it-works, get started steps, or numbered onboarding.

description: Hero with text on left and image on right.
whenToUse: Prompt wants an alternative hero layout with side-by-side text and image.

description: Big promo strip with percentage off and supporting text.
whenToUse: Prompt mentions discounts, promo codes, percentage off, or flash deals.

description: Two customer quotes side by side in bordered cards.
whenToUse: Prompt mentions multiple testimonials or customer quotes side by side.

description: Trusted-by section with caption and 5 brand logos.
whenToUse: Prompt mentions trust signals, "trusted by", "as seen in", or partner logos.

description: Thin top strip with urgent or limited-time message.
whenToUse: Prompt mentions urgent announcements, limited-time banners, or top-bar alerts.

description: Event details grid with date/time on left and location on right.
whenToUse: Prompt mentions event details, date/time + location, conference info, meetup logistics.

description: Dashboard digest card with one hero metric and three supporting metrics.
whenToUse: Prompt mentions data summary, weekly digest, dashboard stats, KPI overview, analytics recap.

description: Oversized pure-typography hero — no image, editorial feel.
whenToUse: Variation seed selects this layout for editorial, newsletter, or premium brand emails.

description: Full-width image with semi-transparent card floating over it.
whenToUse: Variation seed selects this layout for lifestyle, travel, or consumer brand emails.

description: Compact 2-col strip: brand/logo left, headline + CTA right.
whenToUse: Variation seed selects this layout for transactional or compact SaaS emails.

description: Alternating rows of image + text, narrative storytelling layout.
whenToUse: Variation seed selects this for emails that need a storytelling or case-study features section.
